title: Flood, Sudan, 24 September 2024 (FL20240924SDN)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Flood, Sudan, 24 September 2024 (FL20240924SDN), from 1 dataset on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: FL20240924SDN**  This map illustrates satellite-detected water extent in El Geneina Department, West Darfur State, Sudan as observed from a Pléiades image acquired on 25 September 2024 at 11:46 local time. Within the cloud free analysed area of about 20,000ha, a total of about 8050ha of lands appear to be affected with flood waters.
This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
